The investigation examines whether the company made materially false or misleading statements regarding its financial stability and failed to timely disclose financial pressures.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Alnylam Pharmaceuticals following the company's October 29, 2026 earnings report. Alnylam reported significant slowing in demand for its key drug Amvuttra, which represents 87.5% of product sales, with U.S. transthyretin demand declining from $129 million to $81 million quarter-over-quarter. The announcement triggered a sharp 25.13% stock price decline.

top.title: Type 2 Diabetes Clinical Trial and Competitive Landscape Analysis: 200+ Key Companies Shaping the Future of Type 2 Diabetes Therapeutics Space | DelveInsight
top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive report on the Type 2 Diabetes competitive landscape, analyzing 200+ pipeline drugs from 170+ active players. The report highlights recent approvals including Eli Lilly's FOUNDAYO (orforglipron) and Novo Nordisk's once-weekly insulin options, alongside promising pipeline therapies targeting various mechanisms of action. Key developments include positive Phase III results for CagriSema, elecoglipron, and other novel GLP-1 receptor agonists, with approximately 60+ drugs in late-stage development.

reasons.en: negative-gamma tape — dealer hedging amplifies the move (fuel for a breakout)
reasons.zh: 负 Gamma 行情 — 做市商对冲放大波动（利于突破）

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band
reasons.zh: 空头 Gamma 扩张 — 已实现波动升高，无抑制带

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -2.3 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -2.3 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Multiple pharmaceutical companies are advancing investigational treatments addressing unmet medical needs in dermatomyositis, polymyositis, and inclusion body myositis.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: A Capgemini study reveals that 59% of enterprises have experienced AI costs significantly higher than expected, with spending exceeding budgets by an average of 24%. Only one-third of leaders can confidently estimate indirect AI costs like human supervision and content rework. Most companies cannot directly link AI spending to business value, with only 20% calculating AI Yield. Over 60% of executives plan to adopt multi-model AI strategies within a year to optimize costs and performance.

top.title: Most organizations plan to adopt a multi-model AI strategy, as nearly six in ten faced significantly higher AI costs than expected
top.summary: A Capgemini survey of 500 CXO-level executives reveals that 59% of organizations experienced significantly higher AI costs than expected, with spending averaging 24% above budget. Only 56% are confident in forecasting future AI costs. In response, organizations are adopting multi-model strategies and focusing on AI Yield metrics to better align spending with business outcomes, though only one in five currently calculates this metric.

A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Management expects fiscal 2027 revenue of $195-205 million (30% growth), though Q4 2026 showed slight revenue decline and margin compression. CEO Cheri Beranek announced plans to retire by March 31, 2027.

top.title: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages CVRx, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - CVRX
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against CVRx, Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased common stock between July 25, 2023 and August 6, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that CVRx made materially false and misleading statements regarding revenue growth, sales practices, regulatory compliance, and reimbursement strategy. Specifically, the company allegedly engaged in improper marketing of Barostim, kickbacks, and provided false information to government health insurance programs, exposing it to liability under the false Claims Act and Anti-Kickback Statute. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is January 8, 2027.

top.title: Gainey McKenna & Egleston Announces A Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against CVRx, Inc. (CVRX)
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against CVRx, Inc. in the U.S. District Court for the District of Minnesota, alleging that the company and its executives failed to disclose illegal sales practices, including improper marketing of Barostim, kickback payments, and false information to government health insurance programs. The lawsuit claims CVRx's revenues were partially derived from unlawful conduct and that the company made materially false statements regarding compliance, revenue growth, and internal controls. The class period covers purchases between July 25, 2023 and August 6, 2026.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Key challenges include road permits, corridor restrictions, and labor scarcity in specialized operations.

top.title: project44 Turns Supply Chain Data Into AI-Powered Decisions with Snowflake
top.summary: project44 announced an integration with Snowflake to advance AI-powered supply chain decision-making through Mo, an AI supply chain analyst. Mo combines project44's logistics intelligence and 1 trillion shipment records with Snowflake Cortex AI to deliver data-grounded answers to complex supply chain questions. In testing, Mo outperformed general-purpose language models on accuracy (10/10 vs 2/10), consistency (10/10 vs 2/10), and speed (2.5x faster). The platform is already being used by 210 customers including Ford Motor Company.

top.summary: Gildan Activewear faces a securities class action lawsuit for allegedly failing to disclose material information regarding channel stuffing practices. According to Google's 2025 report, over 480 million publisher pages had ads blocked or restricted in 2025.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

top.title: Immutep Further Expands United States Patent Estate for Efti-Based Combination Therapies
top.summary: Immutep Limited announced the grant of US patent 12,788,796 for combined preparations of eftilagimod alfa (efti) with PD-1 pathway inhibitors for cancer and infection treatment. This is the fifth patent in the family, expiring March 23, 2038, strengthening the company's intellectual property protection for efti-based combination therapies. The patent covers combinations with multiple immunotherapy agents including durvalumab and atezolizumab.

top.summary: The global peptide therapeutics market is projected to grow from $112.20 billion in 2026 to $229.32 billion by 2036 at a 7.4% CAGR, driven by GLP-1 and incretin therapies, oral peptides, radioligands, and generic competition. Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk lead the market with blockbuster incretin products, while emerging opportunities include oral macrocyclic peptides, radioligands, and generic semaglutide following patent expiry in major markets.

top.title: Global Injectables Market is Anticipated to Surpass USD 1 Trillion Mark by 2034 | DelveInsight
top.summary: The global injectables market is projected to grow from USD 765 billion in 2025 to USD 1.6 trillion by 2034, with a CAGR of approximately 9%. Growth is driven by rising adoption of biologics, biosimilars, GLP-1 therapies, and advances in drug-delivery technologies like prefilled syringes and auto-injectors. North America leads with 39% market share, while Asia-Pacific represents the fastest-expanding region. Key developments include West Pharmaceutical Services' Dublin expansion and Fresenius Kabi's U.S. manufacturing collaboration.

top.title: Peptide Therapeutics Market: Global Size, Share, Trends and Forecast to 2036 | Set to Reach $229.32 Billion as GLP-1, Oral Peptides, Radioligands, and Generics Fuel Growth
top.summary: The global peptide therapeutics market is projected to grow from $112.20 billion in 2026 to $229.32 billion by 2036 at a 7.4% CAGR, driven by GLP-1 and incretin therapies, oral peptides, radioligands, and generic competition. Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk lead the market with blockbuster incretin products, while emerging opportunities include oral macrocyclic peptides, radioligands, and generic semaglutide following patent expiry in major markets.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: LEN INVESTOR ALERT: Lennar Corporation Investors with Substantial Losses May Seek to Lead the Lennar Class Action Lawsuit – RGRD Law
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Lennar Corporation alleging securities fraud related to improper capitalization of costs, the Millrose spin-off being used to artificially inflate financial performance, and undisclosed related-party transactions. The lawsuit covers stock purchases between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026, with significant stock price declines following disclosure of accounting irregularities and a short-seller report revealing Millrose purchased over 700 homes from Lennar at above-market rates.

top.title: Millrose Properties, Inc. Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Rental Home Business and 8.5% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq., at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
top.summary: Millrose Properties faces a securities class action lawsuit after failing to disclose a $200 million rental home business acquired from parent company Lennar. The undisclosed venture, allegedly operating at a loss, was revealed by Hunterbrook Media on October 2, 2026, causing the stock to plummet 8.5% from $24.61 to $22.51. Investors who purchased securities between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026 have until December 8, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive competitive landscape report on GLP-1 receptor agonists and incretin-based therapies, covering 200+ pipeline drugs from 180+ active players. The report highlights approved drugs like MOUNJARO (tirzepatide) and OZEMPIC (semaglutide), with 30+ therapies in late-stage development and 60+ in mid/early stages. Key indications include obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular outcomes. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for retatrutide, survodutide, and other dual/triple agonists from major pharmaceutical companies.

top.title: Type 2 Diabetes Clinical Trial and Competitive Landscape Analysis: 200+ Key Companies Shaping the Future of Type 2 Diabetes Therapeutics Space | DelveInsight
top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive report on the Type 2 Diabetes competitive landscape, analyzing 200+ pipeline drugs from 170+ active players. The report highlights recent approvals including Eli Lilly's FOUNDAYO (orforglipron) and Novo Nordisk's once-weekly insulin options, alongside promising pipeline therapies targeting various mechanisms of action. Key developments include positive Phase III results for CagriSema, elecoglipron, and other novel GLP-1 receptor agonists, with approximately 60+ drugs in late-stage development.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-0.8 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-0.8 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-1.2 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-1.2 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +3.2 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +3.2 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

The company expects gross and net margins exceeding 50% and has contracted with German suppliers to expand manufacturing capacity in South Carolina.

Market growth is supported by packaged coffee affordability, specialty adoption, app-based ordering, and premium prepared-coffee occasions.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: De “Célébrer de petites occasions” à devenir des habitués : OpenTable dévoile comment les Québécois trouvent de nouvelles raisons de manger au restaurant en 2027
top.summary: OpenTable released its first Quebec restaurant trends report showing that 65% of Quebec diners plan to visit restaurants as often or more frequently in 2027, with an average of eight visits per month. Despite budget consciousness, diners are seeking value and quality experiences. Key trends include celebrating small occasions (69%), becoming regular customers at neighborhood spots (22%), and prioritizing value for money (85%). Restaurant reservations on OpenTable grew 9% year-over-year, with 16 Quebec establishments recognized among Canada's top restaurants.

top.title: GLP-1 RAs & Incretin-based Therapies Competitive Landscape Analysis: Key Developments by 200+ Companies Shaping the Treatment Landscape | DelveInsight
top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive competitive landscape report on GLP-1 receptor agonists and incretin-based therapies, covering 200+ pipeline drugs from 180+ active players. The report highlights approved drugs like MOUNJARO (tirzepatide) and OZEMPIC (semaglutide), with 30+ therapies in late-stage development and 60+ in mid/early stages. Key indications include obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular outcomes. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for retatrutide, survodutide, and other dual/triple agonists from major pharmaceutical companies.

top.title: Global Injectables Market is Anticipated to Surpass USD 1 Trillion Mark by 2034 | DelveInsight
top.summary: The global injectables market is projected to grow from USD 765 billion in 2025 to USD 1.6 trillion by 2034, with a CAGR of approximately 9%. Growth is driven by rising adoption of biologics, biosimilars, GLP-1 therapies, and advances in drug-delivery technologies like prefilled syringes and auto-injectors. North America leads with 39% market share, while Asia-Pacific represents the fastest-expanding region. Key developments include West Pharmaceutical Services' Dublin expansion and Fresenius Kabi's U.S. manufacturing collaboration.

top.title: Arvinas to Present at Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference
top.summary: Arvinas, a clinical-stage biotech company specializing in protein degradation therapies, announced management participation in a fireside chat at the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference on November 18, 2026. The company will present preliminary clinical data from early monotherapy dose escalation cohorts of ARV-393 (Zaloblideg), a PROTAC BCL6 degrader, at the 2026 American Society of Hematology Annual Meeting, including safety, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics data.

top.title: Idiopathic Inflammatory Myositis Market Set for Strong Growth at 16.8% CAGR Through 2036, Driven by Rising Demand for Targeted Therapies | DelveInsight
top.summary: The Idiopathic Inflammatory Myositis (IIM) market is projected to grow at 16.8% CAGR through 2036, reaching significant expansion driven by rising disease awareness, improved diagnostics, and an expanding pipeline of targeted therapies. The market was valued at USD 714 million across the 7MM in 2025, with the US accounting for 55% of the market. Multiple pharmaceutical companies are advancing investigational treatments addressing unmet medical needs in dermatomyositis, polymyositis, and inclusion body myositis.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: negative-gamma tape — dealer hedging amplifies the move (fuel for a breakout)
reasons.zh: 负 Gamma 行情 — 做市商对冲放大波动（利于突破）

reasons.en: clear runway to the call wall with put-wall support below

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band
reasons.zh: 空头 Gamma 扩张 — 已实现波动升高，无抑制带

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -2.8 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -2.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: AI in Drug Discovery Market to Reach USD 15,536.2 Million by 2033 at 25.1% CAGR | Coherent Market Insights
top.summary: The global AI in drug discovery market is projected to grow from USD 3,240.0 million in 2026 to USD 15,536.2 million by 2033, with a CAGR of 25.1%. Growth is driven by increasing pharmaceutical investments in AI infrastructure, machine learning adoption, and collaborations between pharma companies and AI providers. North America leads with 51.6% market share, while Asia Pacific shows the fastest growth at 27.2% CAGR. Key trends include generative AI for molecule design, multimodal AI for biological data analysis, and growing focus on AI model validation.

top.title: GLP-1 RAs & Incretin-based Therapies Competitive Landscape Analysis: Key Developments by 200+ Companies Shaping the Treatment Landscape | DelveInsight
top.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive competitive landscape report on GLP-1 receptor agonists and incretin-based therapies, covering 200+ pipeline drugs from 180+ active players. The report highlights approved drugs like MOUNJARO (tirzepatide) and OZEMPIC (semaglutide), with 30+ therapies in late-stage development and 60+ in mid/early stages. Key indications include obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular outcomes. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for retatrutide, survodutide, and other dual/triple agonists from major pharmaceutical companies.

top.title: Nucleic Acid Labeling - Global Strategic Business Report 2026: Secure Share of a $2.8 Billion Market by 2032 as Thermo Fisher Scientific, Roche, Merck, and Agilent Accelerate Genomics
top.summary: The global nucleic acid labeling market is projected to grow from $1.7 billion in 2025 to $2.8 billion by 2032, expanding at a 7% CAGR. Growth is driven by advances in genomics, molecular diagnostics, NGS, and high-throughput laboratory workflows. Key applications include oligonucleotide labeling and in-situ hybridization, with the U.S. and China representing major regional markets.

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.5 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: AI in Drug Discovery Market to Reach USD 15,536.2 Million by 2033 at 25.1% CAGR | Coherent Market Insights
top.summary: The global AI in drug discovery market is projected to grow from USD 3,240.0 million in 2026 to USD 15,536.2 million by 2033, with a CAGR of 25.1%. Growth is driven by increasing pharmaceutical investments in AI infrastructure, machine learning adoption, and collaborations between pharma companies and AI providers. North America leads with 51.6% market share, while Asia Pacific shows the fastest growth at 27.2% CAGR. Key trends include generative AI for molecule design, multimodal AI for biological data analysis, and growing focus on AI model validation.

top.summary: DaltonTx announced the appointment of Melissa Landon, Ph.D., as Chief Commercial Officer to lead commercial strategy and expand adoption of its Dalton platform across pharma, biotech, and CRO partners. Landon brings 20+ years of AI/ML experience in drug discovery, most recently from Merck KGaA/MilliporeSigma, and previously served as Chief Strategy Officer at Cyclica.

top.summary: Sanuwave Health reported Q3 2026 revenues of $8.6 million, down 24% year-over-year, with a GAAP operating loss of $1.1 million compared to operating income of $0.9 million in Q3 2025. The decline was primarily driven by CMS proposed rule changes affecting reimbursement rates and a market 'wait and see' approach, which reduced Ultramist system sales to 40 units from 155 in the prior year. However, the company noted positive developments including a 14% increase in HOPD rates and removal of Q1 status from the 97610 code.

Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk lead the market with blockbuster incretin products, while emerging opportunities include oral macrocyclic peptides, radioligands, and generic semaglutide following patent expiry in major markets.

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -6.6 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -6.6 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +19.1 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +19.1 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Global Injectables Market is Anticipated to Surpass USD 1 Trillion Mark by 2034 | DelveInsight
top.summary: The global injectables market is projected to grow from USD 765 billion in 2025 to USD 1.6 trillion by 2034, with a CAGR of approximately 9%. Growth is driven by rising adoption of biologics, biosimilars, GLP-1 therapies, and advances in drug-delivery technologies like prefilled syringes and auto-injectors. North America leads with 39% market share, while Asia-Pacific represents the fastest-expanding region. Key developments include West Pharmaceutical Services' Dublin expansion and Fresenius Kabi's U.S. manufacturing collaboration.

top.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has announced an investigation into Xerox Holdings Corporation for potential securities fraud. On October 29, 2026, Xerox sharply cut its full-year 2026 financial outlook, reducing adjusted operating income guidance from $555-605 million to $450-475 million and free cash flow from approximately $250 million to $50-100 million. The company also suspended its common and preferred dividends. Following the announcement, Xerox's stock price fell $1.12 per share (40.14%) to $1.67. The investigation examines whether Xerox and its executives made materially false or misleading statements regarding operational stability, cost headwinds, and cash flow projections.

top.title: ZJK Establishes Six-Series Precision Component Product Matrix to Expand Robotics Opportunities
top.summary: ZJK Industrial (NASDAQ: ZJK), a precision parts manufacturer, announced the establishment of a six-product series portfolio for the robotics industry, including precision gear transmission, linear motion components, and specialty fasteners. The company is collaborating with e-commerce logistics enterprises and humanoid robot manufacturers on R&D and testing. ZJK leverages advanced manufacturing capabilities including five-axis CNC machining and aviation-grade materials to meet stringent robotics industry requirements.

top.title: Peptide Therapeutics Market: Global Size, Share, Trends and Forecast to 2036 | Set to Reach $229.32 Billion as GLP-1, Oral Peptides, Radioligands, and Generics Fuel Growth
top.summary: The global peptide therapeutics market is projected to grow from $112.20 billion in 2026 to $229.32 billion by 2036 at a 7.4% CAGR, driven by GLP-1 and incretin therapies, oral peptides, radioligands, and generic competition. Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk lead the market with blockbuster incretin products, while emerging opportunities include oral macrocyclic peptides, radioligands, and generic semaglutide following patent expiry in major markets.
